headline: Hold the release. 2 of 5 checks failed. First problem: it rejected the signed test event (401).

steps.label: Your webhook answers
steps.saw: It answered with a 401, so it is reachable.

steps.label: It accepts a signed event
steps.saw: It rejected the signed test event (401).
steps.meaning: Real payments are signed the same way, so they would be rejected too and no customer would get access.
steps.next_step: Check that the webhook secret in your server matches the one in your Razorpay dashboard, then run the check again.

steps.label: It grants access and says so
steps.saw: Not tried, the event was rejected.

steps.label: Your pay page opens
steps.meaning: Customers cannot reach the page, so they cannot pay and Razorpay sees no attempt.
steps.next_step: Check the route and the deploy, put the page back, and run the check again.

steps.label: Checkout opens on it
steps.saw: Not tried, the page did not open.

cannot_see: Your code. I only see how your endpoint and your pay page answer.
Every event type. The test is one payment.captured event with a marker id, so a handler that breaks on refunds or subscriptions would pass.
A change that goes live after this check. Run it again after the release as well.
